responsibility: This implementation module parses a textual command line into individual arguments using ARRAY OF CHAR buffers, handling whitespace skipping, single- and double-quoted substrings, and backslash escapes while returning nul-terminated results. It belongs to the gm2 command-string processing utilities and provides the concrete tokenization routines behind CmdArgs.GetArg and CmdArgs.Narg, distinct from Args/SArgs which read the live process argv.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the CmdArgs pair: unlike CmdArgs.def, which only declares GetArg/Narg, this file contains the parsing machinery such as GetNextArg, CopyUntil, and escape/quote handling for tokenizing a command string.
